nodes.description: CLI process operator: parses arguments, loads and validates configuration, builds the app, and hands it to the single worker HTTP server. Starts the lifecycle and receives its return.
Single-process ASGI HTTP server and event loop bound to settings.host:settings.port. Drives ASGI lifespan startup before serving and shutdown on termination.
JSONC configuration adapter: resolves {"env": ...} references and produces validated domain Settings (models, pairs, timeouts, compression workers).
Composition root. Constructs the httpx client, Headroom compressor, JSON event sink, Switchyard router, HTTPX transport, and Gateway, then wraps them in a FastAPI app with the lifespan.
Application core orchestrating routing, compression, and forwarding through injected ports. Holds process-local _positions and _cooldowns state that begins empty each start.
Pooled async HTTP client shared by the transport. Its lifetime is owned by the composition root and released by client.aclose() on shutdown.
Headroom structural compression adapter. Owns one execution thread plus a worker-count semaphore that bounds running and queued submissions.
Single worker thread running synchronous Headroom compression off the event loop. Joined by executor.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=True) during close.
JSON-lines event sink shared by the app and Gateway; serializes gateway-owned records and never raw payloads or dependency exceptions.
Process stdout stream that receives the startup record. The sink of the startup-event branch.
Switchyard stage-routing adapter constructed with the stage policy. Construction only stores the policy; no SDK call happens at boot.
Backend transport adapter wrapping the injected pooled client; no connection is opened at construction.
Ingress factory. Builds the FastAPI application, records the supplied lifespan context manager, and registers the routes.
ASGI application returned to uvicorn. On lifespan startup it enters build_app's lifespan context manager; on shutdown it resumes it.
Async context manager wrapping the app lifetime: emits a startup event, yields while the server serves, then in finally releases the HTTP client and the compression executor.

Absent interaction: build_app constructs the client and executor before uvicorn.run owns them, so a bind/start failure aborts the process without ever entering the lifespan and without any shutdown path (bootstrap.py:26-35, 71-78).
Absent interaction: no shutdown/stopped event is emitted on orderly teardown, so startup is observable in JSON logs but shutdown is not (bootstrap.py:39-46).
